verdict.rationale: Fivetran's REST API lets you set up, scale, and manage pipelines programmatically (fivetran-docs-3, fivetran-docs-22, fivetran-docs-36), and the official Fivetran MCP server can run in a hosted HTTP or stdio transport mode suitable for automated/agentic invocation (fivetran-docs-61, fivetran-probe-4). The Connector SDK also supports scripted connector deployment (fivetran-docs-2, fivetran-intdir-5). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented CLI flags for non-interactive/headless runs, and independent confirmation of automated CI usage.
